slot_scores.name: purchase_beginning_of_month_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can you sell units that you purchase in the same month, or must purchased units be held in inventory until the following month before they can be sold?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about same-month availability of purchased units, which covers part of the hidden timing issue, but did not explicitly confirm that purchases occur once at the beginning of each month.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Purchases occur once at the beginning of each month, or at least before sales, so a single monthly purchase quantity P_t is available before S_t in the inventory balance.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent confirmed only that units purchased in a month can be sold in that same month, but never confirmed the beginning-of-month/once-per-month purchase timing; READY_TO_MODEL then used an inventory balance that treats P_t as available before S_t.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot H1 was only partially resolved: same-month sales were confirmed, but the beginning-of-month/once-per-month purchase timing was not explicitly confirmed.

summary: The agent asked several useful clarifying questions, including one that partially addressed purchase/sales timing, but it stopped before fully resolving the P1 timing slot about purchases occurring at the beginning of each month.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
